foregroundRepair.guide: 이음새를 보정한 5레벨 배경을 1408×704로 확대하고 오른쪽 전경에만 자주색 표시를 놓았다.
foregroundRepair.prompt: Precise local repair of the supplied golden-brown pixel-art fantasy tavern interior. Image 1 is the exact full 2:1 inpaint canvas: replace only the solid purple foreground region. Image 2 is the exact scene without a mask and establishes camera, original objects, warm amber palette and low-resolution pixel-art texture. In this lower-right region, replace the confusing oversized cut-off foreground wooden slab and detached raised stone pieces with uninterrupted warm oak plank flooring, aligned to the same vanishing point and board rows as the floor on the left and behind. The rear structural column just above the edit stays, with its masonry footing finished as one readable two-course stack on the floor. Continue the existing base stones and the wall/floor junction to the right edge, with the same angles and elevations. Match the existing darker side-floor values. Make all edges hard stylized stepped pixels. Keep the current crop, upper windows, roof and both structural side arches exactly positioned, preserve the LEFT foreground entrance trim and the entire rest of the room. No new furniture, no extra props, no changes to lighting, no text, characters or UI. No purple, no seams, no blend strips, no relocated pillars. Return one full-bleed 2:1 image.

guide.note: 각 기존 배경을 최근접으로 768×512에 맞춘 뒤 중앙에 붙인 가이드다.

postprocess: 확장 단계에서는 생성본의 랜드마크를 정렬해 중앙 기준 그림 주변에 새 외곽을 맞췄다. 이음새를 다시 그린 최종본은 기존 배치 기준에 정렬한 뒤 전체의 주변광을 같은 양으로 보정해 한 장으로 저장했다.
